wiki.title: Lonnie Randolph
wiki.extract: Lonnie Marcus Randolph (born August 7, 1949) is a Democratic member of the Indiana Senate, representing the 2nd District since 2008. He earlier served from 1993 through 1998, leaving to become a judge for the East Chicago City Court.
